text:
elaine_sales: Hey team — FinBank wants an EU-only POC for regulatory review. They require subprocessor attestations, BYOK KMS in eu-west-1, and strict tenant pinning. Can we confirm what's doable on hosted vs dedicated?

jordan_se: short answer: hosted API doesn't currently support customer-managed KMS in EU. Dedicated or Private can. Need to know if they need BYOK HSM or just KMS key import.

elaine_sales: They asked for HSM-backed BYOK and no cross-border egress. Also want automatic failover within EU only. Is that a hard requirement?

lucy_sec: @elaine_sales HSM BYOK is supported in Private (on-prem/VPC) with our KMS integrations. For Dedicated we can do KMS in customer project region but HSM-level attestation will need legal review. Subprocessor list for EU regions is available — will send attestation package. :lock:

sam_sre: Failover within EU only — we can implement tenant pinning to EU zones and a prefer-eu failover. However, capacity constraints mean we need reserved Dedicated capacity to guarantee throughput during failover. If we allow cross-region fallback (non-EU) we'd avoid capacity commits but that violates requirement.

elaine_sales: Pricing question from customer: how much extra for reserved capacity vs hosted fallback? They want a number to present in next-day deck.

jordan_se: Quick estimate: Dedicated reserve (small pool) ~ $12k/mo for 4x GPUs + support; Private with BYOK + attestation is higher, ~ $25k/mo + setup. If they need HSM attestation/legal add-on, add one-time compliance review fee. I'll pull exact numbers from pricing sheet.

lucy_sec: Sending quick checklist they asked for: subproc list, SOC2/ISO certs, data flow diagram, KMS architecture note. ETA EOD tomorrow. Also need Security Questionnaire answers — ask them to mark high-priority questions.

deploy-bot: @channel new doc uploaded: https://redwood.internal/attestations/finbank-eu-poc (uploaded by lucy_sec)

elaine_sales: Thanks. Action items: 1) @lucy_sec upload attestation pack (EOD) 2) @jordan_se confirm Dedicated SKUs + price (tomorrow) 3) @sam_sre validate tenant pinning config and capacity plan (end of week). Will loop in legal after attestation is in.

sam_sre: ack, will prototype a prefer-eu routing config. snippet:
```
routing:
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  fallback_policy: prefer-eu
  tenant_pin: true
```

jordan_se: noted — if customer will accept "EU primary, US fallback with contractual egress restriction" we can offer hosted with discounted failover. Otherwise Dedicated/Private only. :thinking_face:

elaine_sales: Perfect. I'll push for clarification in the call. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
